title: Nondeterministic program compilation
statement: Let $A$ be a nondeterministic register program with $m$ registers and $d$ deciders, let $l_0$ be an initial program label, and let $D$ be a deterministic Turing machine with $k_D$ work tapes. For each decider, choose a state of $D$ via a map $q_0$. The compiled nondeterministic Turing machine has $m+k_D$ work tapes and starts in the program state at $l_0$; whenever $A$ makes a binary choice, its two transitions proceed to the corresponding successor labels, and otherwise it uses the compiled deterministic instruction transition, including the simulation of $D$ when required.
